interaction: Stateless Responses tool dialogue: replay every returned reasoning/message/function_call item and paired function_call_output. Ordinary initial question unchanged. No retry of incomplete responses. Per-call output cap is min(32768, remaining total budget minus input reservation and 256 framing padding. Initial input is bounded by serialized request bytes; continuations reserve previous billed input plus output and the new tool-result bytes. Observed input must not exceed that reservation); all input and output tokens, including cached input and thinking, are charged. Insufficient reservation is censored, not savings.
annotationRubric: Extract atomic reasoning episodes ONLY from the supplied external model reasoning. Return exact contiguous quotes, zero-based occurrence, a single concluded atom [relation, integer arguments], the ordered premises EXPLICITLY stated in that quote as atoms, and kind derive/reuse/mention/conditional_recheck/uncertain. Relations are edge, path, ready. ready f means both paths of needs row f. Option IDs are not fragment IDs. A derive episode must contain an inference and actual support, not just an asserted result or a reference to evidence. A reuse episode cites an established result without deriving it. Empty premises are allowed for references and uncertainty, but do not invent edges or fill support from source. Alternative edge chains stay different. Changed value/resource checks are conditional_recheck, not source-path repetitions. Use uncertain for ambiguity. A quoted literal fragment ID must agree with the atom; never silently repair a model's wrong ID. Path endpoints and premise numbers must occur in the quote. Extract explicit negative claims too, using polarity false; absence of derivation is not evidence of absence of thinking. You are blind to arm, score and cost, although reasoning can reveal supplied evidence. Do not invent an episode to fill a category. Native source truth is checked independently after extraction. Quotes must occur verbatim. Return every explicit relevant episode you identify; completeness and independent-rater agreement are unvalidated.
annotationRules: Use exact quoted thinking, independently true source atoms and explicitly supported edge chains/conjunctions. Mark repeated qualified conclusions within the same immutable source, and separately identical ordered-premise repeats. Different parent paths do not reset prior derivations. Resource/value recalculation, mentions, reuse and uncertainty are excluded. Missing labels are unknown, never zero. No completeness or inter-rater agreement claim.
protocol: Each arm starts with the same strictly nonoptimal feasible seed and one empty search prefix. Every call chooses one parentId/optionId extension from the supplied frontier. Invalid branches consume cost and are retained. Baseline receives raw task data; facts adds the same relevant verified Fact outcomes used by scheme; scheme adds ancestor-closed proof fragments and Library finite-absence partition. No branch ranking is performed by Scheme. The host independently grades prefixes and complete selections. Unused reservations and call-limit stops are censored, not savings. Compare only jointly reached input-plus-all-output checkpoints. Labeling costs are separate measurement costs.
